title: Demand records: no Work Package without an Issue or authorized demand
objective: Make 'no WP without an Issue or authorized demand' enforced, not stated: an in-tree, integrity-locked demand record that intent, init and every shipped WP must resolve, human-authorized unless it is a BADF discovery.
business_value: init (WP-0015) could create a WP from a six-field intent with no demand at all -- the pattern GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md forbids. The gate makes zero network calls, so the record is the only form of demand it can verify offline.
in_scope: load_demand + init demand binding in scripts/badf_gate.py
demand required in intent and work-package schema
demand records for every shipped WP (RECONSTRUCTED where pre-doctrine)
out_of_scope: network verification of Issue existence at gate time
acceptance_criteria: demand for another repository is refused
agent-authorized non-discovery demand is refused even when integrity passes
every shipped WP resolves its demand
WP created by init carries demand and held_because names it
demand and WP records are schema-walked (required keys + enum values)
evidence: mutation: 6 mutants / 6 kills on load_demand + init binding, unique anchors
negative control: forged demand -> integrity drift (exit 1); re-signed agent-authorized demand -> refused on principal_type

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR; demand records are additive

note: Deviation from Issue #22's proposal: it said the PropTech intake 'must cite a PropTech Issue'. PropTech has zero Issues and its [WP-NNNN] tokens are its own work, so the intake demand is recorded as an operator decision (BADF-DEM-0003, RECONSTRUCTED). Demand IDs are allocated sequentially and never encode the Issue number; the first export (#19) was renamed from DEM-0019 to DEM-0004 in this WP before it ever landed.
